translation.title: Ketoconazole Topical Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the following skin conditions caused by yeasts: dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis and pityriasis versicolor.
translation.usage: Apply this medicine to the infected area (trunk, face, scalp, hair), leave it on for 3 to 5 minutes like an ordinary shampoo, and then rinse it off. For treating dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis, apply it twice a week for 2 to 4 weeks, and to prevent recurrence, once every 1 to 2 weeks. For treating pityriasis versicolor, apply it once a day for up to 5 days, and to prevent recurrence, as a single regimen once a day for up to 3 days before sun exposure.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, or on a scalp with wounds or inflammation or on severely eroded (raw) areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, for children, or if you are or have been hypersensitive to propylene glycol. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it in the eyes (not for ophthalmic use); apply it carefully so it does not touch the eyes, and if it accidentally gets into the eyes, rinse them completely with plenty of water. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you use it together with antifungals of the same class (such as miconazole, econazole or isoconazole). Adverse reactions may occur - burning at the application site, conjunctivitis, eye irritation, increased tearing, hair loss, hypersensitivity of sensation, folliculitis, pustules, rash, tenderness, acne, dry skin, skin disorders, abnormal hair texture, changes in hair color, taste disturbance and hives; if hypersensitivity symptoms or irritation occur, stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature away from moisture and light, and keep out of reach of children.
